plugins.name: vibeguard
plugins.description: Know what Claude Code is about to do, before you approve it. Plain-English red / orange / green cards on every permission prompt, network egress policy you can enforce instead of guessing, and content pinning for installed skills so a skill that changes after you approved it cannot quietly run.
